entities.summary: Demetrios Capetanakis or Kapetanakis or Capetanaces was a Greek poet, essayist, and critic. For the last five years of his life (1939-1944) he lived in Britain and associated with the Bloomsbury Set, wrote some poetry in English. Dimitrios Capetanakis was a journalists & chroniclers from İzmir (1912-01-22, İzmir–1944-03-09). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
